'''February 2001 Munich tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Funtainment, Munich, Germany on 17 February 2001. [[Quirin Fuergut]] won it. It is known from Quirin Fürgut's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1748">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-munich-ralltiir-02-17-2001d1748/ munich-ralltiir-02-17-2001], DeckTech (Quirin "el-diablo" Fuergut, 19 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-munich-ralltiir-02-17-2001d1748/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Funtainment, Munich, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Quirin Fuergut]]
